proposals.evidence: DEDR4892 directly gives Tamil/Malayalam mukil, Kannada mugil and Parji malgur cloud. Survey Irula mukilɨ and Kannada muyɨlɨ/muyulu are comparative final-vowel and medial-consonant variants; their complete transcriptions remain unchanged. Parji malgur is an exact dictionary match. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1279 explicitly gives Parji kerba egg (plural kerbel), under the embryo/egg family. Survey kɛrbā matches this Parji form with its vowel notation retained, rather than being linked solely by resemblance to Gondi or Indo-Aryan forms. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
